title: Poco F9 Ultra: the new bet from Xiaomi that drives searches
seoTitle: Poco F9 Ultra: Xiaomi's new bet driving searches
subtitle: The Poco sub‑brand launched its new flagship smartphones, the F9 Ultra and F9 Pro, worldwide, generating great interest.
excerpt: The global launch of the Poco F9 family, featuring the Ultra and Pro models, caught attention for its high‑end specs, powerful battery and gaming‑focused features.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The smartphone market and tech‑savvy users turned their attention to the launch of the new generation of Poco's F series, the sub‑brand of Xiaomi. On Tuesday, September 1, the Poco F9 Ultra and Poco F9 Pro were presented globally, quickly becoming some of the most searched topics, especially the Poco F9 Ultra.

The new flagship generation from Poco

The Poco F9 family consists of the F9 Ultra and F9 Pro models, both positioned in the flagship segment. The phones arrive with promises of robust batteries, enhanced sound in partnership with Bose, and high‑refresh‑rate displays, features aimed at a demanding audience that values performance and multimedia. Both devices use Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 processor, but they have important differentiators in their configurations.

Details of the Poco F9 Ultra

The Poco F9 Ultra, the more advanced model, stands out with an OLED screen that can reach a 185 FPS refresh rate, delivering fluidity for gaming and navigation. In terms of performance, the device is equipped with the VisionBoost D8 chipset and a 3D IceLoop cooling system, which claims to keep temperatures 3 °C lower, ensuring stable performance. The phone scored 4,165,108 points in the AnTuTu benchmark, a result considered a record for Poco.

For gamers, the F9 Ultra offers technologies such as the WildBoost Engine for stable frame rates, enhanced game colors, and a high touch‑sampling rate of 4,800 Hz, supporting up to ten touch points at 480 Hz. The sound system was developed with Bose and includes a subwoofer plus two speakers, delivering richer bass in various scenarios.

On the camera side, the Poco F9 Ultra features a quad‑camera rear setup: a 200 MP main sensor, a 50 MP ultra‑wide, and a 50 MP periscope lens with 5× optical zoom. The front camera is 32 MP. The Ultra houses an 8,050 mAh battery with support for 100 W wired fast charging and 50 W wireless charging. Overseas variants will offer up to 16 GB of RAM and 1 TB of storage.

The Poco F9 Pro and its specifications

The Poco F9 Pro shares many specifications with the Ultra, such as the 185 Hz display and the 200 MP main camera. However, it comes in a more compact form, with a 6.59‑inch OLED screen, and does not include the subwoofer found in the Ultra. The chip used is the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, but in its V Series variant, which has slightly lower graphics capability.

The Pro is equipped with a 6,330 mAh battery and the same fast‑charging support as the Ultra (100 W wired). Its rear camera array consists of a 200 MP main sensor, a 50 MP telephoto lens with 2.5× optical zoom, and an 8 MP ultra‑wide lens. Color options include Black, White and Aurora Green. Internationally, the Pro will be available with 12 GB of RAM and up to 512 GB of storage.

Prices and availability in Brazil

Suggested prices for the Poco F9 Ultra start at €1,099 (about R$ 6,569), with a launch promotional price of €829 (R$ 4,955). The Poco F9 Pro is priced at €899 (R$ 5,373) full price and €739 (R$ 4,417) promotional. So far, no official information has been released about the launch date or pricing of the new Poco models in the Brazilian market.

September: a month of launches in the mobile market

The launch of the Poco F9 line marks the beginning of a busy period for the smartphone market. September promises a series of major releases from various manufacturers, including Apple, Xiaomi, Huawei, Vivo, Oppo, Honor and iQOO. The arrival of the new Poco models fits into this intense activity, contributing to the high volume of searches and overall interest in mobile technology news.
